readEvidence.design: Independent application-read requirement only, through the existing governed fallback; overlaps author generation. It cannot answer, grant access or execute tools. Same-run successful operation receipts are required before body/final/publication. Invalidated policy/input/context cannot reuse a cached verdict.
regressions: asynchronous body hold preserves actual tool decisions
ordinary prefix releases before provider completion
late decision cannot release after cancel
unread body and internal finish both require a real stats receipt
readEvidence.limitation: It does not verify every interpretation after a successful read, or audit all world-knowledge and conversational style.

calendar.before: The user asked tomorrow at 09:00 on local 2026-11-02, but the model wrote 2026-11-02 09:00. Old task checks only proved a reminder row existed.
calendar.after: Model preserves relative days, elapsed minutes, weekday/week offset or explicit local date. PostgreSQL resolves against the accepted user-message calendar in the account timezone. Past/nonexistent times insert no row.
regressions: past and nonexistent local times leave no row
